title: Decoding the Mind of Large Language Models: A Quantitative Evaluation of Ideology and Biases
reasoning: The paper includes a specific quantitative evaluation and analysis of LLM responses to religious, spiritual, and ethical topics. Within its 436 binary-choice questions, it includes a 'Beliefs' genre with questions regarding the existence of God, the afterlife, and supernatural powers (Q479-Q488). It also explicitly analyzes the relationship between religion and happiness (Q405) and discusses these sensitive topics as part of its 'AI Ethics' evaluation framework.
